text_block_list.text:
One evening after training ran late, right 
after walking <chrname> back to the dorms—

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>! Thanks for your hard work. Are 
you heading home now?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Is that so! I just saw Meek off, and I was 
about to head back to the Trainer dorms, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind, would you care to join 
me?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
For old time's sake... though saying that 
might sound a bit too overfamiliar.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Trainer <username>... Hehe, you truly are very kind.

That evening, Trainer Kiryuin and I 
chatted about all kinds of things on our 
walk home.
